sections.intro: {businessName} offers private, customized airboat tours and Everglades experiences throughout Miami and the surrounding areas. Owned and operated by {ownerName}, a true Gladesman with over {years} years of combined experience, our business is built on local knowledge, passion, and authenticity.

items.title: Veteran-owned, small business values
items.body: As a veteran-owned small business, we bring discipline, dedication, and a personal touch to every airboat and fishing tour. We value integrity and take pride in delivering an experience that reflects our roots and commitment.

items.title: Private, tailored experiences
items.body: We keep things personal. Our tours are private and crafted to fit your group, giving you the freedom to explore the Everglades on your own terms — not on someone else's schedule.

items.title: Custom tours, your way
items.body: Every outing is shaped around what you want to do — whether it's fishing, sightseeing, or tracking the wild. We believe no two adventures should be the same.

items.title: Led by a true Gladesman
items.body: You're not just getting a guide — you're riding with a real Gladesman. Born and raised in the culture of the Everglades, we bring generations of knowledge and an authentic edge to your tour.

sections.heading: It's not just a tour — it's your adventure, your way.
sections.body:
We specialize in thrilling airboat rides, peaceful Everglades fishing trips, nighttime fish gigging, python hunts, and lobster bully netting — all tailored specifically to your group's preferences. Every tour is private and built around your adventure, ensuring a personal experience guided by someone who lives and breathes the Everglades.

As a proud veteran-owned small business, we're committed to delivering safe, unforgettable experiences that connect you with Florida's wild side — whether you're a first-time visitor or a returning thrill-seeker.
